name: 水感补水轻透贴片面膜款
description: 水感精华补水保湿、柔软膜布服帖、草本温和滋养

styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for packshots and trust screens, flat ice-blue #E4F2F9 water-themed panels for benefit and info shots, white marble #F2F4F5 for scene shots
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft high-key studio lighting, front-left key with fill, soft contact shadows, cool tone, no harsh speculars
styleLock.surfaceSystem: white marble counter #F2F4F5 and water-gloss ice-blue panels
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep blue-grey #2F3B45, all copy wrapped in 「」; sky-blue #5FA8D3 reserved for thin-line icons and accent rules, not for body text
styleLock.iconSystem: thin-line circular icons, single sky-blue accent color #5FA8D3
styleLock.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, box upright with sachets fanned, consistent product scale across the set, every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, ice blue #E4F2F9, deep blue-grey text #2F3B45 and one sky-blue accent #5FA8D3; bright soft high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft contact shadows, cool tone; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in #2F3B45 with all copy wrapped in 「」; consistent thin-line circular icons in one accent color; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal water-themed infographic elements; stable product scale and placement with the box upright and sachets fanned; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, soft contact shadow grounding the set
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The box standing upright with sachets fanned in front, photographed at a slight front 3/4 angle, eye-level, full product visible. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, a soft contact shadow grounding the set. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product set occupies 35-40% of the frame centered on the vertical axis, and the even white field closes the composition so the frame reads as one complete clean packshot. 8K, commercial beauty e-commerce quality. Negative: no props, no hands, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no cut-off edges, no gradient background.

provenance.notes: 从 10 张爆款补水贴片面膜详情长图切片提炼；已剥离原品牌字样、模特形象、原文案、会员二维码水印，产品一律以 {product} 占位；源图中的焕白提亮、28天焕新、90%数据等未证实宣称全部舍弃，旧版信任镜的空徽章占位改为封边工艺与膜布质感的可验证呈现，痛点空图格改为干肤质感隐喻实拍。
